people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Hadadezer
people.line: King of Zobah, defeated by David.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Rehob
people.line: Father of Hadadezer, king of Zobah

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
translations.bsb: from Edom and Moab, from the Ammonites and Philistines and Amalekites, and from the spoil of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
translations.kjv: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
translations.asv: of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
